home.title: Turn paper forms into digital forms
home.description: Upload a document or scan. FORMIQ detects form fields so you can check them against the original and prepare a file for import into COI.

upload.title: Upload a form
upload.description: Add a document or scan in Forms. Mark it as paid and run the analysis.

review.title: Review the result
review.description: Compare the detected fields with the original and correct the extracted values.

export.title: Download the form
export.description: Save the reviewed form as a JSON file ready to import into COI.

capabilities.title: What you can do in FORMIQ

compare.title: Find a field in the original
compare.description: Open the result alongside the PDF or scan. When the analysis finds a field’s location, you can highlight its label and where the answer goes.

edit.title: Correct and validate answers
edit.description: Change extracted values in the form preview. The editor flags errors such as an invalid PESEL number, date or bank account number. Saved changes are included in the JSON download.

decisions.title: Review suggested fields
decisions.description: When the analysis flags a field for review, you can see why it was suggested and decide whether to add it to the draft as an optional field.

manage.title: Return to saved forms
manage.description: Search by filename, filter by format or analysis status, and reopen a saved result. You can run the analysis again on the same file if needed.

capabilities.availability: Preview, editing and decision review depend on the file format and analysis result.

formats.title: File formats you can upload
formats.description: Upload several forms at once, up to {mib} MiB per file. You can add scans, text documents and spreadsheets.
